name: aip
description: Edit talking-head video into a finished cut with AI Producer: the agent prepares an editable workspace, while AIP transcribes, scores, restyles, previews and exports it.

interface.shortDescription: Cut, caption and animate a talking-head video
interface.longDescription: Edit an attached talking-head video: cut it from the transcript, prepare captions and motion graphics in an AIP-compatible workspace, and use AI Producer for music, restyling, preview and export.
defaultPrompt: Edit my attached talking-head video into a finished cut with AIP.
Cut the dead air out of this video and add captions.
Add motion graphics and music to this video and export the mp4.
